format: ModuleConfig XML schema 2.0 / ModConfig5.0 ecosystem token
locked_decisions: Generate ModuleConfig XML through a typed plan rather than free-form AI XML.
Preserve the schema-defined element order for module, step, plugin, dependency-type, and conditional-pattern nodes.
Treat an omitted destination in an existing XML mapping as the source path, as defined by the XSD.
Emit an explicit empty destination for typed Forge mappings that intentionally install at the Data root.
Reject C# scripted FOMOD installers because they permit arbitrary code execution outside Forge's bounded model.
Require strict payload coverage by default.
Treat equal-destination files in mutually exclusive groups as safe branch alternatives only when alwaysInstall and installIfUsable cannot make them co-install.
Require explicit priority to resolve collisions between branches that can co-install.
Condition flags used by step visibility or dynamic option types must be defined by earlier steps.
Validate the generated tree again after writing it.
Manager installation and presentation remain external Vortex and MO2 runtime gates.
